metadata.title: Playing Defense With Your Portfolio? Here Are Pros’ Stock Picks.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text: Nvidia-related market volatility has investors taking a fresh look at defensive positioning in their equity mix. Led by the ugly headlines about the troubled chipmaker, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq have fallen 2.9% and 3.2%, respectively, since Nov. 13. That’s been particularly painful for those who’ve allowed their allocations to drift over the past few years and become top-heavy with technology. The good news is that there are plenty of high-quality, reasonably priced stocks out there. For this week’s Barron’s Advisor Big Q, we asked investment pros to make the case for their favorites.
